# claude-starter-template

## Project Identity

This is a GTM execution project for `[COMPANY NAME]`.

Goal: convert LinkedIn activity and ICP account lists into qualified pipeline with automated outbound workflows.

## ICP Definition

- industries
- company size
- ARR range
- geography
- decision-maker titles
- tech signals
- hiring signals
- funding signals
- disqualifiers

## Tool Library

- phantom buster
- apollo
- million verifier
- linkedin ads api
- sequencer api

## Output Standards

- save all outputs in `/outputs`
- always include tier and route columns
- never send to invalid or risky emails
- always request confirmation before publish actions
